title: Full-Stack Web Developer
description: Build and ship client web applications end-to-end with React, Next.js and Node.js. You will own features from database design to deployment and work directly with international clients in a fast-moving freelance team.
requirements: Strong JavaScript/TypeScript with React and Next.js
Experience building REST APIs with Node.js
Comfort with Git, cloud deploys and CI/CD basics
Good written English for client communication

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design clean, conversion-focused interfaces for web and mobile products. You will turn briefs and wireframes into polished Figma designs that developers can build without guesswork.
requirements: Strong portfolio of web/app design work
Hands-on Figma skills: components, variants, auto-layout
Understanding of responsive layout and design systems
Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly

title: Mobile App Developer (Flutter)
description: Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter. You will work on real client products, integrate REST APIs and publish releases to the Play Store and App Store.
requirements: Production experience with Flutter and Dart
Comfortable with REST APIs, local storage and state management
Experience publishing to Play Store / App Store
Eye for smooth animations and platform conventions

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Own cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines for client projects. You will automate deployments, harden security and keep environments fast, observable and cost-efficient.
requirements: Deep knowledge of AWS or equivalent cloud platforms
Hands-on with Docker, GitHub Actions and IaC tools
Experience with Linux servers, monitoring and log tooling
Understanding of networking, SSL and DNS
